description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of task types related to article generation. The chart contains two slices, representing “Article generation” and “Task Type”. The “Article generation” slice is red and occupies approximately 83.2% of the chart, while the “Task Type” slice is yellow and occupies approximately 16.8% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice, and the chart includes a legend identifying each category. The slices are arranged adjacently, with the larger slice positioned to the left.
